summary.text: Monica VanBuskirk is the Democratic candidate for the Colorado House of Representatives, District 9, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which she faces Republican Tom Cowhick.
She defeated Neal Walia in the June 30, 2026 Democratic primary and describes herself as a health care policy professional and small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists a bachelor's degree from Smith College in 2002 for Monica VanBuskirk.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has 20 years of experience as a healthcare policy expert, was born in Belize and gained American citizenship, and runs a small business in the district.
She said her work included helping pass laws that brought $400 million back to Colorado to lower healthcare costs and securing $0 mental health visits for nearly 140,000 people.
VanBuskirk's survey lists affordability measures such as tax relief for homebuyers, affordable childcare and utility rates, and protecting families' future, as key messages.
She said she does not take corporate PAC money.
